listing.name: Chasing Santa 5K — Zachary
listing.summary: A family-friendly holiday 5K and half-mile kids run in Zachary supporting the Zachary Charity League.

listing.name: Reindeer Run — Hammond
listing.summary: A holiday 5K and one-mile fun run in Hammond that raises money for Restoration House Pregnancy Resource Center.
listing.description: The Hammond Reindeer Run is a chip-timed 5K and 1-Mile Fun Run that starts and finishes at Cate Square Park. The course goes through the historic district and out and back through Southeastern Louisiana University. The race page says proceeds support Restoration House Pregnancy Resource Center, and that registration closes when the medal supply is filled.
listing.location: Cate Square Park, W. Charles St., Hammond

audience.note: The race page doesn't state age rules or divisions.

listing.title: Maurepas swamp tree planting at Port Manchac (Dec. 19)
listing.summary: Take a short boat ride from Port Manchac and plant bald cypress trees in the Maurepas swamp with the Coalition to Restore Coastal Louisiana.
listing.description: The Coalition to Restore Coastal Louisiana is planting about 4,500 bald cypress trees in the Maurepas swamp. Volunteers take a boat ride of about 20 minutes to the planting site, wear CRCL-provided life jackets and follow the boat captains' directions. Every volunteer must register on CRCL's event page.
listing.location: Port Manchac, by boat to the Maurepas swamp
requirements: Register on CRCL's event page in advance
Minimum age 16; volunteers 17 and younger must be registered by a parent or guardian and accompanied by an adult
Everyone signs CRCL's release and waiver
Wear the life jacket CRCL provides on the boat ride

eligibility.note: CRCL's page: minimum age 16; ages 17 and under must have a parent or guardian complete registration and must be accompanied by an adult.

listing.title: Atchafalaya Basin tree planting near Berwick (Jan. 16)
listing.summary: Plant oaks and hackberry on a dredge-spoil island in the Atchafalaya Basin with the Coalition to Restore Coastal Louisiana.
listing.description: The Coalition to Restore Coastal Louisiana is planting 800 trees over two weekends, including live oak, hackberry, Nuttall oak and overcup oak, on dredge spoil in the Atchafalaya Basin. Volunteers take a boat ride of about 50 minutes from Berwick, wearing CRCL-provided life jackets. Every volunteer must register on CRCL's event page.
listing.location: Berwick, St. Mary Parish, by boat to the Atchafalaya Basin
requirements: Register on CRCL's event page in advance
Minimum age 16; volunteers 17 and younger must be registered by a parent or guardian and accompanied by an adult
Everyone signs CRCL's release and waiver
Wear the life jacket CRCL provides on the boat ride
